question: Can the existing exact P58 layer-major scheduler make the existing P40 device-variant cache materially useful at M=1024 by reusing each layer/expert expanded view across causal rows, without changing one-row expert arithmetic or row-wise join order?

frozen_source.changed_surface: qualification/parser guards plus the existing S0 width list and policy tests only; no scheduler, provider, cache, arithmetic, or join implementation change

validity_repair.trigger: The first launch was stopped during the sequential arm, before any candidate timing was observed, because the same-process verify arm would have inherited P40 identities and frequency-first eviction metadata trained by the sequential arm.
validity_repair.repair_scope: Reuse the existing stream-engine cache allocation, but clear external/P40 identities plus frequency and recency before both prompt rebuilds; expose already-collected P40 counters as per-arm runtime-stat deltas. No arithmetic, route, scheduler, layout, join, performance, or correctness gate changes.

arms: control: the runner's existing 1024 sequential one-row loop with P40 enabled
candidate: the same process and binary, existing P58 exact layer-major width 1024 with P40 enabled, followed by exact one-row ReplaySSM commit

why_m1024.m512: memory-safe but below the approximately M=1008 physical-density crossover and therefore not the first material storage discriminator
why_m1024.m1024: first bounded width above that crossover; projected ReplaySSM input is 1.887 GiB and remains well inside GPU1 capacity
why_m1024.m2048: stronger storage geometry but deferred until M1024 proves the existing P40 representation can convert reuse into live wall time

frozen_bounds.interpretation: The M2048 figures establish reuse headroom but use H23 geometry and are not a fixed96 M1024 performance projection. The run must measure the live prize.

primary_metrics: sequential versus verify physical storage bytes
sequential versus verify logical provider bytes
P40 hit/extension/cold/scatter counters from the existing provider report
correctness_gate: bit-identical all 1024 full-vocabulary logits and argmax rows; identical recurrent and MLA aggregate/per-layer hashes; identical logical provider traffic; zero provider fallback/invalid; physical GPU1; no OOM or swap I/O
performance_gate: verify_plus_commit must be at least 1.20x faster than the same-run sequential control, while verify physical bytes do not increase. A smaller exact win is evidence only and does not earn production phase selection.
abort_conditions: wrong GPU or non-performance platform profile
swap input/output, OOM, or device allocation failure
hidden fallback, arithmetic/join change, or incomplete 1024-row output
repeat_policy: one qualified same-process sequential/candidate comparison; rerun only an INVALID arm, never a valid miss

interpretation.go: retain the default-off width envelope and implement the smallest phase selector: P40 for wide prefill, established P41/P46/P42 chain for width-one/decode
interpretation.no_go: remove the new width gates and preserve only the result; do not tune M1024
interpretation.invalid: repair only the stated validity failure without changing the registered gates
